name: com.gameframex.unity.tuyoogame.yooasset.googleplay
description:
GameFrameX YooAsset GooglePlay — Google Play mini-game FileSystem adapter for Unity WebGL, integrating the Google Play mini-game SDK AssetBundle download and cache workflow into YooAsset. Provides a GooglePlayWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider and GooglePlayFileSystem implementation with a dedicated asset bundle load operation, compiled under UNITY_WEBGL with the GOOGLEPLAYMINIGAME define and depending on YooAsset, StarkWebGL, and GooglePlayWebGL. Docs: https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com

GameFrameX YooAsset GooglePlay — Google Play 小游戏 FileSystem 适配功能包。提供 GooglePlayWebPlayModeFileSystemProvider 与 GooglePlayFileSystem 实现及专属资源包加载操作，在 UNITY_WEBGL 下通过 GOOGLEPLAYMINIGAME 宏编译，依赖 YooAsset、StarkWebGL 与 GooglePlayWebGL。文档：https://gameframex.doc.alianblank.com
